title.text: CO₂ and global temperature over the last 10,000 years
title.subtitle: Ice-core and proxy reconstructions spliced with the instrumental record

values.label: ⇢ splice: ice cores → Mauna Loa (1959) — multi-decadal ice-core resolution before 1959; annual instrumental after
⇢ splice: proxy reconstruction → GISTEMP (1880) — 100-year proxy bins before 1880; annual instrumental after

values.line: Data: CO₂: Bereiter et al. 2015 (NOAA NCEI Paleo study 17975, public data, cite source) + NOAA GML Mauna Loa annual means (public data)
Data: Temperature: Kaufman et al. 2020 Temp12k (NOAA NCEI Paleo study 29712, doi:10.25921/vzys-1280, cite source) + NASA GISTEMP v4 (public data)
